description: Retire outdated notes in favour of a newer one; they stay recoverable. Three actions. preview (old_ids, plus new_id or new_title and new_body): changes nothing and returns a warning and a code; show the warning to the person and wait for yes. confirm: pass that code with the same new_* values; the code works once, expires, and fails if any note changed since the preview. undo (id): bring a replaced note back. To change one note's text, use memory_save with id.

code.description: confirm: the single-use code the preview returned.

new_id.description: An existing note that takes their place. Or give new_title and new_body to create one instead.

new_title.description: Title of a new note to create in their place.

name: memory_replace
title: Replace a note
